items.message: feat: add nickname tag "土撥鼠" for 孫煜哲

資料改存 data 分支：記錄搬遷時 main 上的資料版本

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix: multi-device upload merge, live scorer guards and honest pitching stats

- Uploads (logs, games, avatars, tags, defense rankings, guests) go through one
  commitJsonFile(): if another device saved after this page loaded, this
  device's own changes are merged into the newer cloud copy instead of
  overwriting it; a 409 race re-reads and retries.
- Live scorer: no preset batting result (submit needs a picked result), and no
  new plate appearance or out after three outs until the inning is switched.
- Pitching: half-innings without fielding events are counted as appearances
  only; metrics with no sample show 資料不足 instead of ZCR 100% / sFIP 4.50.
  No hard-coded default pitcher; unattributed events are not credited.
- Review editor: changing a fielding event's type resets its outs to that
  type's default.
- Tests: new ui-data-safety browser suite (two devices), merge/upload unit
  tests, GitHub-like sha checks in the preview server; integrity baseline v5.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
